items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So I stayed with him until I got a job in Detroit working with a six-piece band. I think his name was Hayes, a tenor player -- Tubby, they called him.

ctx.x: But Jimmy Rochelle had a good band. I mean, he kept working all the time, and he paid a fair wage. It wasn't nothin' to brag about, but it wasn't nothin' to cry about either.

So I stayed with him until I got a job in Detroit working with a six-piece band. I think his name was Hayes, a tenor player -- Tubby, they called him. Not Tubby Hayes. This is Tubby we called him. And he had a guy named Johnny something who played piano, and Freddie Radcliff played the drums...
